adversarial.attemptedCounterexample: Compared milk with coffee, honey and flour; otherwise-similar dark chocolate narrows the defining added ingredient to milk, without denying variant sweeteners.
adversarial.scopeDateCheck: Reviewed conventional food/process/botanical identity, not a current ranking; row-specific scope: Compared milk with coffee, honey and flour; otherwise-similar dark chocolate narrows the defining added ingredient to milk, without denying variant sweeteners.
adversarial.funFactCheck: Both actual bodies identify cocoa/cacao beans as the input; Wiki explicitly calls them seeds.
adversarial.sourceIndependenceCheck: Wiki selected chocolate-making introductory narration differs from Britannica kernels/liquor narrative. Its only Britannica citations are Charlie and the Chocolate Factory cultural material, excluded from our selected production/type claims.
adversarial.finalOptionOrderAssessment: Milk supplies the named milk-chocolate distinction; flour, coffee and honey are not that dairy ingredient.
